definitions.explanation: A major road or route, especially one with historical significance. Often refers to the major highways of the Edo period that connected important cities.

examples.japanese: {東海道|とうかいどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧{街道|かいどう}だった。
examples.english: The Tokaido was the highway connecting Edo and Kyoto.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{街道|かいどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{宿場町|しゅくばまち}→宿場町：24771_shukubamachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Post towns were lined up along the old highway.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{街道|かいどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、⟦{参勤交代|さんきんこうたい}→参勤交代：12846_sankinkoutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大名行列|だいみょうぎょうれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This highway is known as a road that daimyo processions used to travel along during the alternate attendance system.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily associated with historical highways, especially the five major routes ({五街道|ごかいどう}) of the Edo period. Also used figuratively in the expression ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧{街道|かいどう} (path to success).
- ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧{街道|かいどう}: the road to success

FAMOUS ROUTES:
- {東海道|とうかいどう}: Tokaido (Edo to Kyoto along the coast)
- {中山道|なかせんどう}: Nakasendo (Edo to Kyoto through the mountains)
- {日光街道|にっこうかいどう}: Nikko Kaido (Edo to Nikko)
